pairs: I saw the Lord standing over an altar,
and let the lintels be shaken.
For there is avarice at the head of them all,
et novissimum eorum in gladio interficiam;
and I will execute the very last of them with the sword.
There will be no escape for them.
et non salvabitur ex eis qui fugerit.
and he who flees from among them will not be saved.
If they descend even to the underworld,
from there my hand will draw them out;
et si ascenderint usque in cælum,
and if they ascend even to the sky,
from there will I pull them down.
Et si absconditi fuerint in vertice Carmeli,
And if they were hiding at the top of Carmel,
et si celaverint se ab oculis meis in profundo maris,
and if they conceal themselves from my eyes in the depths of the sea,
I will command the serpent there and he will bite them.
Et si abierint in captivitatem coram inimicis suis,
And if they go into captivity in the sight of their enemies,
there I will command the sword,
et ponam oculos meos super eos in malum,
And I will set my eyes over them for harm
And the Lord God of hosts,
et lugebunt omnes habitantes in ea:
And all who dwell in it will mourn.
And everyone will rise up like a river,
and will flow away like the river of Egypt.
Qui ædificat in cælo ascensionem suam,
He establishes his ascension into heaven,
et fasciculum suum super terram fundavit;
and he has founded his bundle on the earth.
He calls the waters of the ocean,
et effundit eas super faciem terræ:
and pours them over the face of the earth.
Numquid non ut filii Æthiopum vos estis mihi,
are you not like the sons of the Ethiopians to me,
Numquid non Israël ascendere feci de terra Ægypti,
Did I not cause Israel to rise up out of the land of Egypt,
and the Philistines out of Cappadocia,
and the Syrians out of Cyrene?
Ecce oculi Domini Dei super regnum peccans:
Behold, the eyes of the Lord God are on the sinning kingdom,
et conteram illud a facie terræ;
and I will wipe it from the face of the earth.
verumtamen conterens non conteram domum Jacob,
Though truly, when destroying, I will not wipe away the house of Jacob,
et concutiam in omnibus gentibus domum Israël,
and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations,
sicut concutitur triticum in cribro, et non cadet lapillus super terram.
as wheat is sifted in a sieve. And not even one small stone will fall to the ground.
In gladio morientur omnes peccatores populi mei,
All the sinners of my people will die by the sword.
et non veniet super nos malum.
and it will not overcome us.”
In die illa suscitabo tabernaculum David,
In that day, I will raise up the tabernacle of David,
And I will repair the breaches in its walls,
and I will restore that which collapsed.
et reædificabo illud sicut in diebus antiquis,
And I will rebuild it, just as in the days of antiquity,
so that they may possess the remnant of Idumea
eo quod invocatum sit nomen meum super eos,
for my name has been invoked over them,
says the Lord who does this.
and the plower will overtake the harvester,
and the treader of grapes will overtake the sower of seed.
And the mountains will drip sweetness,
and every hill will be cultivated.
Et convertam captivitatem populi mei Israël;
And I will turn back the captivity of my people Israel.
And they will rebuild the deserted cities
Et plantabo eos super humum suam,
And I will plant them on their own soil.
et non evellam eos ultra de terra sua,
And I will no longer root them out of their own land,
